item: Start-up runs the cache warm-up, the rollup's first build and the re-index resume one after the other
summary: Diagnostics cause C: every restart began three whole-corpus jobs within a minute and the process was killed with all running. One boot thread now runs the warm-up, then the rollup first build, then the re-index resume; the rollup and map serves decline with boot_order while an earlier step runs; a raising, skipped, declined or failed step always releases the next; no timeout, so a stuck wait shows in the bundle's columnar.json boot_sequence block and as a warning at five minutes. Also tests for the rest of the #1284 check S3 and the stoplist steps recorded as paused for budget.
